slug: 2025-07-10 Guinea-Bissau Council of Ministers approves three digital decrees (interoperability, data governance, cybersecurity)

facts.fact: ANG reports the Council of Ministers approved a draft decree (Projeto de Decreto) on the Regulamento sobre a Interoperabilidade de Sistemas e Plataformas Digitais dos Servicos Publicos e Privados, with no number given; date taken from the article's Thursday Council meeting, 10 July 2025.
facts.system: Regulamento sobre a Interoperabilidade de Sistemas e Plataformas Digitais
